events.description: Uniformed personnel in helmets and protective gear advance in formation across a street with burning objects and debris, while civilians and motorcycle riders are present amid chaotic movement.

verification.reason: Frames f4–f8 show coordinated movement of multiple individuals in riot gear near a large ground fire (f5), satisfying the definition of collective violent unrest; frames f9–f13 extend this with continued presence of fire, scattered objects, and motorized movement in the same location—supporting a single sustained riot event. Candidate 7 (24.5–26.8) overlaps but includes heavily blurred frames f14–f16 where actions are unverifiable; since t_end=26.0 is the last clear frame (f13), candidate 7 cannot be fully merged without overextending into uncertain territory, so only candidates 4 and 5 are included in the accepted event.

rejected.reason: Images f4–f6 show a burning vehicle and individuals near it, but no collective violent unrest or crowd behavior indicative of a riot; the scene is consistent with an isolated fire incident or emergency response.
No blast wave, rapid expansion, or debris ejection is visible in f5–f6; the fire appears sustained and localized (e.g., vehicle engulfed), not an explosion event.

No mutual physical combat is visible; frames f4–f5 show a figure moving near a car and another figure in background, but no contact or struggle is evident—motion blur and low light prevent confirmation of fighting.
